product_metadata.title: Lunch Bag, KOMUEE Insulated Lunch Box Wide-Open Lunch Tote Bag Large Drinks Holder Durable Nylon Thermal Snacks Organizer for Women Men Adults College Work Picnic Hiking Beach Fishing (grey)
features: HUGE CAPACITY: KOMUEE lunch bags can accommodate a wide variety of things including salads, snacks, fruit, drinks and lunch boxes. You can hold 2 lunch containers and 2 bottle of drinks in the lunch bag.It can fit all your lunch needs.

PRACTICAL FUNCTION & HIGH QUALITY: KOMUEE lunch bags lining is made of insulated material, which keeps food and drinks warm & fresh for 3 to 24 hours , so you can enjoy fresh food at any time.The use of Eco-friendly EVA material makes it easy to wipe clean, waterproof and leak-proof. Cotton and linen handles are lightweight and portable,the nylon connect by dense stitching makes the lunch bag very durable and safe to carry lunch.

EXCELLENT DESIGN: Wide open design is beneficial to put your lunch boxes into the bag or take out of the lunch bag, avoiding liquid leaking out of food containers and soiling inside of the bag. Save your cleaning time.And the design of the pockets, for you to place small objects.

SUITABLE FOR MANY OCCASIONS: The unisex lunch bag is not only suitable for work and college, but also for outdoor activities such as fishing, hiking and more. It can also be used as a picnic bag and a snack pack. Suitable for all groups, designed for students, office workers and outdoor enthusiasts.

SATISFICING SERVICE: Customer Satisfaction is our top priority. KOMUEE insists on the highest quality materials and manufacturing processes to bring you superior kitchen accessories. Quality products and exquisite packaging will provide you with a satisfying purchasing experience.
